title: Advanced oxidation processes based on non-radical pathways in persulfate systems: a comprehensive review of their characteristics, detection methods, and catalyst design
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27937-27959
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08786D, Review Article
Open Access

Xin Yang, Jiping Cao, Tao Song, Xingyun Hu, Linghao Kong, Zhilin Xia
This review summarizes the mechanisms, reactive species identification, and catalyst regulation strategies of persulfate-based non-radical oxidation processes for selective degradation of organic contaminants in complex wastewater matrices.
